infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow microphone access to count reps by voice.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Allow speech recognition to count reps by voice.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow camera access to count push-ups.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Let users select or celebrate workout photos so they can share progress snapshots and highlight training wins.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Use location data during outdoor workouts so nearby routes, pace stats, and guidance stay relevant to the user.
